lines.zh: 我扇着透明的翅膀飞过蕨叶。
lines.en: I beat my clear wings over the ferns.

lines.zh: 翅膀几乎看不见，只有边是黑的。
lines.en: My wings are nearly invisible, rimmed in dark.

lines.zh: 我在林间高低起伏地飞。
lines.en: I rise and dip through the trees.
I skim over a leaf surface.

lines.zh: 丛林里的光斑在我身上移。
lines.en: Dappled jungle light slides over me.
One wingbeat turns me.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根藤蔓转了一圈。
lines.en: I loop once around a vine.

lines.zh: 我飞得很慢，看得清每片叶子。
lines.en: I fly slowly, seeing every leaf.

lines.zh: 我在一株橙色郁金香上停了停。
lines.en: I pause on an orange tulip.

lines.zh: 我升到树冠下，风把我托住。
lines.en: I rise under the canopy and the wind holds me.

lines.zh: 我从两片叶子之间穿过去。
lines.en: I pass between two leaves.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的透明部分在闪。
lines.en: The clear part of my wings flashes.
I land on a leaf tip, then lift off.
I follow the flower scent deeper in.
I fly low over a stream.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯，回到那丛花。
lines.en: I turn back to that clump of flowers.

lines.zh: 我停在叶上，翅膀慢慢开合。
lines.en: I rest on a leaf, wings opening and closing.

lines.zh: 透明的翅膀在光里几乎消失。
lines.en: My clear wings nearly vanish in the light.
I'm sunning my wings.
The jungle is close and warm.
A bug flies past; I don't move.
I curl my antennae.

lines.zh: 这里的橙色郁金香开着。
lines.en: An orange tulip is blooming here.
I sip a little nectar.
I shift my feet slightly.
The leaf is a little damp.

lines.zh: 我收拢翅膀，安静地待着。
lines.en: I fold my wings and rest.
The wind sways the leaf.
I lift off and hover before you.
Your breath pushes me off course.

lines.zh: 我贴着你肩膀飞了半圈。
lines.en: I fly half a circle past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你身上只有汗和铁的味道。
lines.en: You smell of sweat and iron, not flowers.
I settle on your cuff and taste the air.
You move, and I flit away.
I return to the flower.
Your shadow blocks my sun.
I come a little closer.
I tilt my antennae toward you.
A corner of my wing crumples.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，又挣扎着飞起。
lines.en: I drop, then struggle back up.
Wing dust scatters in the air.
I sink a short way, tilted.
I land on a leaf to rest.
A small piece of wing is gone.
Each beat is an effort.

lines.zh: 我把两对翅膀叠在背后。
lines.en: I fold both pairs of wings along my back.
I can still make it to the next flower.
I hide deep in the leaves.
That's the smell of nectar.

lines.zh: 你把花举过来，我就落下。
lines.en: Hold the flower out and I'll land.
Two beats and I'm closer.
I extend my proboscis.
The flower is orange. Just right.
I circle around your finger.
The sweetness is strong.

lines.zh: 我把口器探进花心，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I run my proboscis into the flower and drink slowly.
Don't touch my wings.
I'd like one more sip.
The bump sets me spinning.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的鳞粉掉了一点。
lines.en: A little wing dust flakes off.
I climb quickly.

lines.zh: 半边翅膜被风扯得发抖。
lines.en: Half my wing membrane trembles in the draft.
You're far too big.
I retreat behind a leaf.
I land on a fern frond.
I slide half a step along the leaf's underside.
At least nothing's broken.
I fly around you.
Another glasswing in the trees.
Its wing rims are broader than mine.

lines.zh: 两只透明翅膀交错打转。
lines.en: Two glass wings turn and cross.
Our wings almost touch.

lines.zh: 我们一起落在一片叶上。
lines.en: We settle on one leaf together.
It flies off first.
I'll lay eggs on the leaf's underside.
The caterpillars will eat this leaf.
The jungle is big enough.
I go back to the nectar.
I land and grip with my feet.
This smells even better than nectar.
I touch it with my proboscis.
It isn't sweet.
I fly off.
I settle back down.
I draw my feet together.
Too heavy for me to lift.
I land on a flower and forget it.
I can't quite hold it.
Something is shifting under the leaf.
I take off.
That isn't wind; those are footsteps.
I spread my wings.
That thing is big.
I'll fly up first.
There's a gap in the canopy.
I keep my eyes on it.
It isn't coming for me.
I settle back down.
It's still below.
I wait on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我扇一下翅膀，换个位置。
lines.en: One beat moves me elsewhere.
It looked up.
I freeze.
Clear wings do help.
It turns away.
I rise one layer.
Safe again.
I land back on the flower.
I beat my wings and raise a puff of scales.

lines.zh: 这一撞用完我半个早晨。
lines.en: That one bump cost me half a morning.
I bump its nose.
Then I'm off.

lines.zh: 我一撞，连灰尘都没扬起。
lines.en: I strike, and not even dust rises.
A faceful of scales, and I withdraw.
I land on a high leaf.
My wings are trembling.
It can't reach me.
I slowly calm down.
I come out of an egg on a leaf's underside.
My wings are still soft; I bask a while.

lines.zh: 绿叶把光滤成了翡翠色。
lines.en: The leaves filter the light to jade.

lines.zh: 翅膀第一次扇动，有点抖。
lines.en: The first wingbeat comes out shaky.
And then I'm flying.
The ferns spread out below.

lines.zh: 我找到一株橙色郁金香。
lines.en: I find an orange tulip.
I land and take a sip.
The sweetness settles me.
I follow the scent away.

lines.zh: 翅膀边缘焦卷了，我往下坠。
lines.en: My wing edges scorch and I drop.

lines.zh: 我摔在落叶上，翅膀摊开。
lines.en: I hit the leaf litter, wings spread.

lines.zh: 水黏住我的翅膀，我扇不动。
lines.en: Water glues my wings; I can't beat them.
The blast blows me far.

lines.zh: 箭从我翅膜中间穿了过去。
lines.en: The arrow punched straight through my wing membrane.
The light leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 花都谢了，我的翅越来越沉。
lines.en: The blooms are gone and my wings grow heavy.
Lightning flashes and I spasm.

lines.zh: 我一直往下掉，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: I keep falling, nothing to catch.
